mathematical_meanings: Left image: x denotes the unknown angle measure at E, in degrees. Right image: x denotes the unknown angle between the line and a side of the square, in degrees.
Rationales: The left occurrence is located at x° at the left vertex E of the pentagon; the right occurrence is at x° immediately above the line to the left of P. Both use the selected notation for the same unknown-angle variable role. This compares the local role, without asserting that the two underlying objects or unknown values are identical.
